patch_description: Adapts the best-performing prior architecture (3-fold rotational symmetry via a 4-point base expanded to 12 points plus center, softmin gradient ascent screening, then exact hill-climb polish), but scales it up per the recommendation: ~70 random base seeds (up from 24), 8 structured seeds, and exact hill-climb polish on the top 10 candidates (up from 4), plus more basin-hopping kicks. The softmin gradient stage is cheap (300 vectorized iterations over 286 triples), so widening the funnel fits comfortably in the runtime budget. The 3-fold symmetric parameterization (13 points determined by 4 base points, i.e., an 8-dimensional search) was exactly what broke the 0.02 plateau, so we keep it as the core and simply multiply multi-start breadth, which the recommendation identifies as the key lever.
